articles.title: Finding bugs in Raft implementations

Despite formal specifications and detailed implementation guides, numerous groups have created open-source Raft implementations with bugs that manifest as violations of the main invariant, state machine safety. This issue affects hundreds of groups worldwide, including HashiCorp Raft, Aeron Cluster, OpenRaft, and MicroRaft, despite investments in formal methods, code review, unit testing, and years of production testing. The consequences of these bugs can be far-reaching and painful to root cause, replicate, and fix.
